title: High throughput wild type measles quantification in settled solids using digital RT-PCR
author: Alessandro Zulli
materials: One-Step RT-ddPCR advanced kit for probes

Retrieve all kit components from the One-Step RT-ddPCR advanced kit for probes from the -20 °C freezer and thaw the components On ice . One-Step RT-ddPCR Advanced Kit for Probes Bio-Rad Laboratories Catalog #186-4021

Briefly vortex One-Step RT supermix for Probes (Yellow Tube), Reverse Transcriptase (Orange Tube), and DTT (Grey Tube) to mix contents then briefly spin with the benchtop centrifuge. One-Step RT-ddPCR Advanced Kit for Probes Bio-Rad Laboratories Catalog #186-4021

For each assay, remove a white cold block from the freezer and place a new Bio-Rad ddPCR 96-well Plate in it. Note that these steps may be completed with a liquid handling robot. We use the BRAVO system.

Bring the BioRad ddPCR plate with Master Mix and samples to the Bio-Rad PX1 PCR Plate Sealer and place it in the metal carrier inside the plate sealer. Do not store the metal carrier inside the plate sealer, as it will become warm and warm the samples during sealing.
For the Droplet Plate: label a new Bio-Rad ddPCR™ 96-Well Plate and place it in the black cooling block.

steps.title: Thaw RNA plate and mix
steps.instruction: Thaw the frozen RNA storage plate on ice, ensure it is sealed, briefly vortex, then briefly centrifuge to mix the samples.

steps.title: Keep RNA on ice
steps.instruction: Keep all extracted RNA samples on ice or in a cold block from the freezer at all times.

steps.title: Prepare fresh nuclease‑free water
steps.instruction: Pour 50 mL Ambion Nuclease‑Free water into a 5 mL Eppendorf tube to create a fresh working stock.

steps.title: Store master‑mix components on ice
steps.instruction: Keep all ddPCR master‑mix components on ice throughout the preparation.

steps.title: Prepare measles ddPCR master mix
steps.instruction: In a 2 mL Eppendorf tube, combine the following per well (22 µL reaction assumed) and store the master mix on ice:

substeps.instruction: 5.5 µL ddPCR™ One‑Step RT Supermix for Probes (Yellow Tube)
1.1 µL 20× Measles Primer/Probe Mix (primers 18 µM each → final 900 nM; probe 5 µM → final 250 nM)
Total 16.5 µL per well (1742.4 µL for a 96‑well plate with 10 % excess).

steps.title: Dispense master mix to plate
steps.instruction: Using a new reagent reservoir, pipette 16.5 µL of the prepared master mix into each well of each ddPCR plate.

steps.title: Transfer samples and controls
steps.instruction: Add RNA and control samples to the ddPCR plate as follows:

substeps.instruction: Transfer 5.5 µL of samples from columns 1‑10 of the RNA plate to columns 1‑10 of the ddPCR plate.
Transfer 5.5 µL of extraction controls from column 12 of the RNA plate to column 11 of the ddPCR plate.
Add 5.5 µL of NTC (water) to wells A‑G of column 12.
Add 5.5 µL of ddPCR positive control to well H12 (add manually even if using a robot).

steps.title: Seal plate with foil
steps.instruction: Align a PCR Plate Heat‑Seal foil on the ddPCR plate with the red line facing up and press the green “seal” button.

steps.title: Vortex and centrifuge plate
steps.instruction: Briefly vortex the sealed plate on a bench‑top plate vortexer, then briefly spin it down in an Axygen plate centrifuge.

steps.title: Store plate before droplet generation
steps.instruction: Place the sealed, vortexed, and centrifuged ddPCR plate on a white cold block or keep it on ice until droplet generation.

steps.title: Configure AutoDG droplet generator
steps.instruction: On the AutoDG, select “configure plate” and press the blue arrow in the upper left corner to highlight all columns.

steps.title: Load AutoDG consumables
steps.instruction: Load three DG32 cartridge plates and two tip boxes (lids removed) onto the AutoDG deck; icons turn red when oriented correctly and green when placed correctly.

steps.title: Place ddPCR plate on AutoDG
steps.instruction: Place the sealed, vortexed, and centrifuged ddPCR plate in the Sample Plate position on the AutoDG deck.

steps.title: Load cooling block
steps.instruction: Remove the AutoDG cooling block from the freezer and place it in the Droplet Plate slot on the AutoDG deck.

steps.title: Generate droplets
steps.instruction: Click “Generate Droplets”; droplet generation takes approximately 00:45:00.

steps.title: Seal droplet plate
steps.instruction: After generation, open the lid, remove the droplet plate from the black cold block, place it in the metal carrier inside the plate sealer, align a heat‑seal foil (red line up), and press the green “seal” button. Do NOT vortex at this point.

steps.title: Thermocycle droplet plate
steps.instruction: Place the sealed droplet plate in the thermocycler and run the program specified in the wild‑type measles ddPCR cycling‑conditions table.

steps.title: Store plate after PCR
steps.instruction: After the PCR program, store the ddPCR plate at 4 °C (in the thermal cycler, on ice, or in a refrigerator) until droplet reading.

steps.title: Prepare droplet reader
steps.instruction: Open the left‑side drawer of the QX200 droplet reader, verify sufficient droplet‑reader oil, and ensure the waste bottle is not overly full.

steps.title: Load plate into reader and run Quantasoft
steps.instruction: Load the plate into the droplet reader (stage → metal brace → press black tabs), click “Run” in Quantasoft, confirm “OK”, and keep settings at “Columns” and “FAM/HEX”.

steps.title: Set assay information
steps.instruction: Open the associated .qlp file, go to the Plate Editor tab, select all wells, choose Simplex/Duplex under Assay Information, and label Signal Ch1 (FAM) as “Wild‑type measles”.

steps.title: Assign or edit sample names
steps.instruction: If sample names were not entered earlier, select the wells, type the sample IDs, and click “Apply”.

steps.title: Deselect unwanted wells
steps.instruction: In the Plate Editor tab, select any wells to exclude and click “Clear Selected Well”.

steps.title: Set multi‑well threshold
steps.instruction: On the 1D Amplitude tab, highlight all wells and press the “Threshold Multiple Wells” button to auto‑set the threshold; suggested value = 1400.

steps.title: Verify droplet counts
steps.instruction: Check each well to confirm proper droplet designation and that >10,000 droplets are present; if a well fails, clear it via the Plate Editor.

steps.title: Merge wells and export data
steps.instruction: On the 1D Amplitude tab, select “Merged Wells”, then click the Table Menu button on the Well Data table and choose “Export to CSV”.

steps.title: Calculate gene copies per gram
steps.instruction: Begin with the QuantaSoft concentration (gc/µL of reaction) from the CSV, then apply the following variables:

substeps.instruction: A = 5 µL template volume in reaction
C = 60 µL elution volume from extraction kit
Z = 0.0225 g wet weight solids per extraction well (300 µL of a 75 mg mL⁻¹ suspension)
Use dimensional analysis to convert gc/µL to copies per gram dry weight; verify calculations against instrument units.
